_comment: The node address rule shared by nodeadm (lanCheck / the enrolment report / cleanAddrs) and the CLI (kube_doc_addresses): strict IPv4 only (the cluster is IPv4 single-stack: octets 0-255, no leading zero, no zone, no IPv6, no IPv4-mapped IPv6). Each value is a unicast LAN address outside the cluster's networks when it's IPv4, so accept is the IPv4 rule alone (review I4).
